name: a2a-compat
description: Check, convert and proxy between A2A protocol 0.3 and 1.0 agents: compatibility matrix, agent card converter and a translating JSON-RPC/SSE proxy.
author: LeeGyeongPil

scripts.build:test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs --test
scripts.test: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --suite default
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --suite e2e
scripts.test:interop: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --suite interop
scripts.test:all: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --suite all
scripts.start: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli/main.js demo
